title: chat-server: populate ChatMessagePush.unreadCount
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00 (spec 6bcd9d8) L149-150: 'unreadCount ... Servers SHOULD include this for platforms that support atomic badge updates'. After JMAP-0x0q.44 the field is typed on ChatMessagePush, but build_chat_message_push (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/push.rs) always leaves it None. Needs the owner's unread total across non-muted Chats at build time (likely a backend hook or a caller-supplied value).
notes: Batch 8b review (JMAP-0x0q.44): crate-jmap-chat-server/src/push.rs:410 fit_chat_message_push doc says split payloads keep unreadCount (true by construction: push.clone() copies every field but messages), but tests/chat_push_fit.rs never sets unreadCount; add it to splits_an_oversized_batch_without_losing_entries (L135) and assert every split payload carries it.
close_reason: Batch 19 (run wf_1f7c9883-837): implemented, adversarially verified, full CI green at b9d3d860
